text: [3] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ viharati savighātaṃ saupāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ kāyassa [1]- bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā katamehi pañcahi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu assaddho hoti ahiriko hoti anottappī hoti kusīto 2 hoti duppañño hoti imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ viharati savighātaṃ saupāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā . pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme sukhaṃ viharati avighātaṃ anupāyāsaṃ apariḷāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugati pāṭikaṅkhā katamehi pañcahi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho hoti hirimā hoti ottappī hoti āraddhaviriyo hoti paññavā hoti imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme sukhaṃ viharati avighātaṃ anupāyāsaṃ apariḷāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugati pāṭikaṅkhāti .
